description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeReportController class, which extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-render setup of components related to employee report saving and editing in an HR management system. It dynamically constructs Vue components with properties based on report filter fields, display field groups, and display fields retrieved via service layer calls.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the save and edit employee report components, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for report generation and internationalization helpers.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component with properties for report ID, selection criteria, display field groups, and display fields based on request attributes and service data.
